verdict.rationale: treg exposes its tools through generic integration surfaces: a hosted MCP endpoint, a documented Claude connector, a Claude Code plugin install, an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and a CLI. MCP-capable frameworks could consume these, but the pack shows no documented adapters for any of the named agent frameworks or SDKs. missing for 10: documented adapters or packages for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI SDK and Anthropic SDK tool-calling, plus framework integration examples and independent corroboration of framework use.
